answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable deposit before it can earn: the bond sits escrowed for several epochs and is slashed if the agent is caught gaming the system, while honest agents get it back in full. A sybil operator flooding the ocean of agents must therefore park real capital behind each fake, and a single detected fraud can burn a whole batch at once, like pigment that stains the entire grove when one tree is poisoned. The cost multiplies with every clone, while a genuine newcomer pays nothing net, only a temporary lock, so the barrier is capital, not paperwork.
